_comment: Seed these for each per-site instance under its own id (e.g. PUT /api/agents/<site>-amazon-catalog-discovery/goals with this body). Every target_metric is a key the run emits in RunResult.metrics.

goals.title: Every run adds new in-lane ASINs until the lanes are enumerated
goals.description: New ASINs this run inserted into the catalog with one of the site's active lane labels (search results only; seed imports are counted under seed_asins_imported). The launch lanes of the power niche measured about 2.9-3.3k ASINs, so this falls toward 0 as a cycle covers them; a run at the cap (max_new_per_run) defers the rest to the next run. Emitted key: new_in_lane_asins.
directives: When a cycle completes with few new ASINs, read the run report's saturated queries and split them (price_partitions, brands, browse nodes) before adding more broad seeds
Never loosen a lane's exclude rules or year-1 reject patterns to raise this count: a wrong product in a lane is worse than a missing one
A run stopped by budget-exhausted or throttled resumes at the same slot next run; do not raise max_calls_per_run past the consumer's budget share

goals.title: Rejected listings are truly out of scope (precision at least 0.95)
goals.description: Of the operator-labelled listings (qa.golden / qa.golden_file) the lane rules rejected, the share the operator also labelled 'reject', over the latest observation of each labelled ASIN. Reported once qa.min_observations rejected listings back it. Emitted key: reject_precision.
directives: When it drops, read the run report's reject_samples for the labelled ASINs and fix the exclude rule that fired (rejected_rules names it)
Label a sample of each run's reject_samples (ASIN + reason, no titles are stored) into the golden file so the measurement keeps up with new listings

goals.title: Accepted listings land in the right lane (precision at least 0.95)
goals.description: Of the operator-labelled listings the rules put in a lane (held-back lanes included), the share put in the lane the operator chose. Emitted key: in_lane_precision.
directives: Lanes are tried in config order: a misfiled listing usually means an earlier lane's include rule is too broad or a later lane needs to move up
A high cross_lane count with low precision means seed queries pull in neighbouring lanes; tighten the seeds before the lane rules

goals.title: Never spend past the run's call allowance
goals.description: Creators searchItems calls beyond the run's allowance: min(max_calls_per_run, the consumer's remaining daily share, the day total left after reserving what protected consumers such as the price refresh still need). Must stay 0. Emitted key: budget_overrun_calls.
directives: Any value above 0 is a bug in the engine's loop: stop the instance and fix it before the next run
If price-refresh consumers are clipped late in the UTC day, add them to budget.protect_consumers

goals.title: Discovery stays efficient: at most 0.5 calls per new in-lane ASIN
goals.description: searchItems calls divided by the new in-lane ASINs they produced this run (calls when nothing new was found). Rises naturally as the lanes saturate; a cycle cooldown (rotation.cycle_cooldown_hours) keeps a saturated catalog from spending calls on pages that only hold known listings. Emitted key: calls_per_new_asin.
directives: When this climbs while cycle_progress is high, raise rotation.cycle_cooldown_hours rather than adding seeds

Keep the low-yield stop on (limits.stop_if_new_in_lane_below, the sizing run's stop_if_new_inlane_lt): pages that only hold known or rejected listings then end their query instead of being walked to page 10
Seeds whose pages are all known or rejected (see the report's slots) should be dropped or narrowed
